description: Is this address safe to pay? OFAC sanctions, ERC-8004 reputation, contract analysis.
name: io.trust-agent/trustagent-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Service to query. Defaults to the hosted deployment.
environmentVariables.name: TRUSTAGENT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Private key of a funded Base wallet. Enables the four paid tools, which settle per call in USDC over x402. Omit to run the free tools only — they need no wallet. Requires the optional peer dependency x402-fetch.
environmentVariables.name: TRUSTAGENT_WALLET_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Refuse any single paid call above this amount.
environmentVariables.name: TRUSTAGENT_MAX_PER_CALL_USD

environmentVariables.description: Total spend ceiling across all paid calls in one session. A model looping on a retry is the realistic failure, and a per-call limit does not catch it.
environmentVariables.name: TRUSTAGENT_MAX_SESSION_USD

title: TrustAgent — counterparty verification
